nyheter.title: Peacoat Evicted from Navy Seabags After a Century at Sea
nyheter.summary: The traditional Navy peacoat will be no more. A new Navy uniform policy released on Friday removes the peacoat, acrylic V-neck sweater and dinner dress white jacket from a sailor’s seabag beginning on Oct. 1, 2027. Sailors may still wear the wool V-neck sweater. Instead of the dinner dress white jacket, sailors will now use the dinner dress blue jacket as the standard formal uniform year-round, according to the policy. The trials will serve as the initial stage of the Royal Navy’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) program, which will see attack drones operate alongside its embarked F-35 Lightning II fighter aircraft. nyheter.title: Navy Quietly Removed USS Michael Murphy Commander in September
nyheter.summary: The Navy quietly relieved the commanding officer of a naval destroyer initially deployed as part of the Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group, USNI News has learned. The Navy relieved Cmdr. Caitlin Cunningham on Sept. 27 due to a loss of confidence, a Navy spokesperson confirmed Tuesday to USNI News.
